description: This file defines the ModifyColumnGenerator class, which generates SQL statements to modify existing table columns for various database types within a Liquibase migration context.

classes.name: ModifyColumnGenerator
classes.description: A class that generates SQL for modifying table columns across different database systems within Liquibase migrations.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Returns warning messages related to the modify column operation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the modify column statement for correctness before SQL generation.

methods.name: generateSql
methods.description: Generates an array of SQL statements to perform the column modifications for the target database.

methods.name: supportsExtraMetaData
methods.description: Checks if the target database supports additional metadata like DEFAULT values and NOT NULL constraints during column modification.

methods.name: getModifyString
methods.description: Returns the database-specific string used for modifying a column, such as 'MODIFY' or 'ALTER COLUMN'.

methods.name: getPreDataTypeString
methods.description: Returns the string prefix used before the data type when altering a column for specific databases.

methods.name: getPostDataTypeString
methods.description: Returns the suffix string after the data type, e.g., closing parentheses for Oracle databases.

methods.name: getDefaultClause
methods.description: Constructs the DEFAULT clause for a column if a default value is specified and supported by the database.
